newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: COLOMBIAN PESO EDGES BACK TO 1,119 VS DLR.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBIAN PESO EDGES BACK TO 1,119 VS DLR.

text.p: Colombia's peso edged up a wafer- thin 65 centavos to 1,119 against the dollar in steady trading Monday, interbank dealers said.
"The market was stable today. Industry was buying and selling dollars, banks maintained long positions and there was minimal influx of export earnings into the market," one dealer said.
The peso opened at 1,120 and traded between the day's high of 1,119 and an intraday low of 1,120.7. Dealers reported 282 trades worth a total $129 million.
